Conditions:

I. If the first element is an odd number and the last also is an odd number, the code for the first element will be P and for the last element will be K.

II. If the last two elements are numbers the codes for these two are to be interchanged.

III. If the first two elements are symbols, both these elements will be codes as UU.

What will be the code for 3$7%68?

According to the given condition:

 
 

 
 
Rule no.

Result

 
 
 

 
 
I

Code for the first element will be P and for the last element will be K

 
 
 

 
 
II

Codes for these two are to be interchanged

 
 
 

 
 
III

 
 
 
First two elements are symbols

 
 
 
Both elements will be codes as UU

 
 
 

Given: 3$7%68

Here, II rule applies i.e. last two elements are numbers.

3 → coded as W 

$ → coded as F

7 → coded as N 

% → coded as C

6 → coded as Y (As codes interchanged)

8 → coded as G (As codes interchanged)

So, 3$7%68 → Coded as WFNCYG

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
